name: Something Happened Today
source:
"One day I realized that my life had gone awry. That's when it all started..."

    Aynos is an avid stay-at-home person who appears on the street less often than you can catch a lunar eclipse, gets into a very strange and awkward situation. Now he is suffering at the cost of his peace of mind, personal space and further down the list. His head is spinning and his nerves are running out.

"Hey, Ke, you're written or counted flies?!"

    From now on, Aynos has to accept that his existence wouldn't be the same as before.

"It's right: "what kind of friendship you make, you will lead such a life"."

[From [url=https://cyborg-cant-eat-pizza.itch.io/something-happened-today]itch.io[/url]]
